newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany confirms release of nationals in Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Germany confirms release of nationals in Yemen.

text.p: Germany's Foreign Ministry confirmed on Sunday that four German tourists kidnapped in Yemen had been released and said that its ambassador was meeting them in Sanaa, the Yemeni capital.

"I am relieved that the four kidnapped German tourists have been freed," Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said in a statement released in Bonn. "They have just now arrived in Sanaa and are meeting Ambassador Helga Strachwitz...They are in good condition considering the circumstances."
Earlier a spokesman for the foreign ministry said there would be no confirmation of the release until the ambassador had personally seen the two men and two women.

In Yemen, the governor of the Marib province, Yahia al-Shaief, told Reuters that Yemeni security forces had freed the hostages and arrested the kidnappers after firing artillery shells near their hideout.
The four were abducted by tribesmen on March 27 while returning to the Sanaa from Marib.
